issue.title: Config reload with VNET and VxLAN tunnel configuration results in error in syslog "Cannot create vxlan Vxlan1"

failure.body:
#### Description

#### Steps to reproduce the issue:
1.  Add vxlan tunnel configuration (e.g. sudo config vxlan add tunnel1 <IP>)
2. sonic-cfggen -a "{\"VNET\": {\"Vnet1\": {\"vxlan_tunnel\": \"tunnel1\",\"vni\": \"1\"}}}" --write-to-db
3. sudo config save -y
4.  sudo config reload -y

#### Describe the results you received:
Jan  6 <IPV6>.858785 r-lionfish-16 WARNING swss#vxlanmgrd: :- doVxlanDeleteTask: Vxlan(Vnet Vnet1) hasn't been created
Jan  6 <IPV6>.874014 r-lionfish-16 INFO swss#/supervisord: vxlanmgrd RTNETLINK answers: File exists
Jan  6 <IPV6>.924868 r-lionfish-16 WARNING swss#vxlanmgrd: :- createVxlan: Fail to create vxlan interface Brvxlan1
Jan  6 <IPV6>.924868 r-lionfish-16 ERR swss#vxlanmgrd: :- doVxlanCreateTask: Cannot create vxlan Vxlan1

#### Describe the results you expected:
No errors in syslog

resolution.title: [Vxlanmgr] vnet netdev cleanup during config reload fix
resolution.description:
**What I did**

Fixes https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/issues/9709

Enhanced the Existing cleanup methods i.e. `getAllVxlanNetDevices` & `clearAllVxlanDevices` to also include any stale Brvxlan interfaces and remove them.

Added a vs-test to simulate the scenario.

**Why I did it**

Config reload with VNET and VxLAN tunnel configuration results in error in syslog "Cannot create vxlan Vxlan1"

```
Jan 6 <IPV6>.858785 r-lionfish-16 WARNING swss#vxlanmgrd: :- doVxlanDeleteTask: Vxlan(Vnet Vnet1) hasn't been created
Jan 6 <IPV6>.874014 r-lionfish-16 INFO swss#/supervisord: vxlanmgrd RTNETLINK answers: File exists
Jan 6 <IPV6>.924868 r-lionfish-16 WARNING swss#vxlanmgrd: :- createVxlan: Fail to create vxlan interface Brvxlan1
Jan 6 <IPV6>.924868 r-lionfish-16 ERR swss#vxlanmgrd: :- doVxlanCreateTask: Cannot create vxlan Vxlan1
```

**How I verified it**
